QuestInfo.name: [Catch the Wind] Cassandra's Windy Fun
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a favor to ask of you...
QuestInfo.1: Hunt regular monsters and bring Cassandera #b50 Toy Pinwheels#k. But #rmonsters 11 or more levels lower, or 21 or more levels higher than you#k won't have them!

0.0: Hi, #h0#! Are you enjoying your long weekend? Silly question, I know. Hey, I had an idea for something to do since the weather's so nice... Wanna help?

yes.0: Score! Okay, so, like, bright and breezy days are perfect for pinwheels. So I went to the local Meso Tree and bought a whole mess of cheap ones. But then, out of the blue, monsters stole them all! Will they every stop being huge jerks? Probably not. SO! I need you to hunt regular monsters and get me #b50 #i3994735# #t3994735# items#k. As usual, #ryou won't find any on monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you#k!

no.0: Dude, do we really need to go through this every time I ask? Just say yes already.

default.0: Where are my 50 Toy Pinwheels? Don't say 'With the monsters.'
